HomePage.faqTitle: Learn kana: hiragana and katakana quiz FAQ
HomePage.faq1Question: What can I practise with this kana quiz?
HomePage.faq1Answer: This kana quiz covers hiragana and katakana, alone or together. Choose a kana group (seion, dakuon or yōon) and a quiz mode, then answer ten questions with instant feedback on the correct kana and romaji.
HomePage.faq2Question: What makes this hiragana and katakana quiz different from other kana tools?
HomePage.faq2Answer: Not through a full spaced-repetition algorithm. The quiz does weight characters you have answered incorrectly more heavily, and you can see how many characters you have practised and mastered in this browser.
HomePage.faq3Question: How often should I take the hiragana and katakana quiz?
HomePage.faq3Answer: Practise for 15–20 minutes a day rather than one long session. Short, repeated rounds of the kana quiz beat cramming, and your browser keeps a record of which kana you have answered correctly.
HomePage.faq4Answer: Stroke order is not part of the hiragana and katakana quiz; the written guides cover stroke order, and the quiz focuses on recognition, listening, matching and spelling.
HomePage.faq5Question: How is this different from other kana tools?
HomePage.faq5Answer: Most learners can learn hiragana and katakana in three to six weeks with short daily sessions. The kana quiz weights the characters you get wrong, so practice time goes where it is needed.
HomePage.faq6Answer: Yes — accuracy and per-character mastery are stored in your browser local storage, so they survive a refresh but do not sync between devices or browsers.

Course.title: Your 7-unit kana course
Course.subtitle: Start with one row of kana at a time, then build up to dakuten, yōon, special sounds and katakana.
Course.finalTestDesc: 10 mixed questions across everything you have learned.
Course.lockedHint: Finish earlier units to get the most out of this one.

u1.title: Seion ① — あ・か・さ rows
u1.goal: Read and write あいうえお, かきくけこ and さしすせそ, one row at a time.

u2.title: Seion ② — た・な・は rows
u2.goal: Add たちつてと, なにぬねの and はひふへほ to your reading.

u3.title: Seion ③ — ま・や・ら・わ rows and ん
u3.goal: Finish the seion with まみむめも, やゆよ, らりるれろ, わを and ん.

u4.title: Dakuten and handakuten
u4.goal: Hear the difference between か and が, は and ば／ぱ, and read all 25 voiced kana.

u5.title: Yōon — small ゃ・ゅ・ょ
u5.goal: Blend a consonant with ゃ, ゅ or ょ: きゃ, しゅ, ちょ and the rest.

u6.title: Special sounds — っ, ー, ん
u6.goal: Sokuon (small っ), long vowels and the moraic ん in real words.

u7.title: Katakana and loanwords
u7.goal: Read loanwords like コーヒー and ファン, plus combinations such as ティ and ウィ.
